title: Chimera
author: BlackRaven
rules:
Solve in SudokuPad

Normal sudoku rules apply.

Place some circles in the grid such that a digit only appears once in a circle and two circles cannot share a row, column or box.

A circle either creates zipper lines or region sum lines in the following way:

Zipper lines: There will be 4 lines of lenght X (the digit in the circle): vertical, horizontal and both diagonals with the circle in the center. Digits on the lines which are of equal distance from the center sum to X. Digits may repeat on lines if allowed by other rules.

Region sum lines: Box borders divide the lines into segments of equal sums. A circle that creats these lines will have only one vertical, one horizontal and one diagonal component which all start from the circle and have the lenght of the digit in the circle (including the circle). A valid circle will have at least a line that crosses a box border. Lines from different circles can cross or overlap. If that happens, the lines dont form one big line, they remain individual and with their respective sum.

The purple circle is a zipper circle. The black circle can be either type. Only lines from a circled 3 cannot go through the orange border but may touch it at a point. A digit in a diamond is the sum of the circles in its row and column. If circled 1 exists, it's only purpose should be completing a diamond's total. Digits separated by a V sum to 5. Digits separated by a X sum to 10. Digits on a pink line form a consecutive set in any order. An inequality sign points to the smaller digit.
solutionCode:
Circled digits in normal reading order - Column 1
Ex: 9371-123456789
